svg.title: HeatSense — know the field, protect the practice
svg.desc: The official HeatSense H mark. Field WBGT readings, UIL guidance, timed rechecks and shared practice records for coaches, athletic trainers and athletes. The wearable band is in development.

g.text: Know the field. Notice the athlete. Act early.
EXPO / REACT NATIVE · FIREBASE AUTH + FIRESTORE · THREE ROLE EXPERIENCES
